ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT tl N8. AGREEMENT (the"Agreement"),made as of thisα day of December,2007,between Tony Seiden, residing at 300 Mercer Street, Apt. #5E, New York, NY 10003 ("Owner"), and Syms Corp., having an address at One Syms Way, Secaucus, New Jersey 07094 (hereinafter referred to as "Purchaser"). RECITALS: A. Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and                s Block 19, Lot 18, which is more particularly described in Schedule "A" annexed hereto (said land being herein called "Owner's Land," said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being herein called "Owner's Building," and Owner's Land and Owner's Building sometimes being referred to hereinafter collectively as "Owner's Property"). B.1 Purchaser owns certain land, with buildings and improvements thereon, located at 42 Trinity Place, New York, New York, and the tax lot at Block 19, lot 13,which is more particularly described in Schedule "B" annexed hereto (said land being herein called "Purchaser's Land", said building, with any future replacements thereof or alterations or additions thereto, being herein called "Purchaser's Building" and Purchaser's Land and Purchaser's Building are sometimes referred to hereinafter collectively as "Purchaser's Property"). C. Purchaser intends to modify Purchaser's Building or construct a new Purchaser's Building upon all or a portion of Purchaser's Land. The parcels comprising the Owner's Land 1 313045-1-W

and Purchaser's Land are herein sometimes referred to hereinafter collectively as the "Parcels" and each individually as a"Parcel." D.The tracts of land comprising Owner's Land are contiguous for a distance of more than ten (10) linear feet on their common boundary with the tract of land comprising Purchaser's Land, and the tracts of land comprising Owner's Land and the tract of land comprising Purchaser's Land are all within a single block and may lawfully constitute a Single Zoning Lot as that term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended (the "Zoning Resolution"). E.It is anticipated that Purchaser's modified or new Building will contain more floor area, as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter referred to as "Floor Area"), than is now available for use under the Zoning Resolution for Purchaser's Land as an independent "zoning lot," with the result that Purchaser and Owner desire to merge Purchaser's Land and Owner's Land into a single "zoning lot" pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to enable Purchaser's Building to incorporate unused Floor Area attributable to Owner'sLand. F. There exist Development Rights (hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Owner's Land which are in excess of the Development Rights utilized by Owner's Building and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (such excess Development Rights, the “Available Development Rights").As used in this Agreement, the term "Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in 2 313045-1-W
